description.short_caption: Erythematous and desquamating rash on the lower leg with marked swelling.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the lower leg of a patient with diffuse erythema, swelling, and areas of desquamation. The skin appears shiny and tense, suggesting significant edema. There are also marked areas of peeling skin and some darker markings, possibly indicating prior skin markings or lesions. The findings are consistent with an inflammatory or infectious process involving the skin and subcutaneous tissues.
visible_findings: darker markings on the skin surface

description.short_caption: Erythematous lesion on the right shoulder.
description.detailed_description: The image shows the right shoulder of a patient with a single, well-demarcated, erythematous lesion. The lesion appears circular, with a slightly raised border and central clearing. The surrounding skin is unremarkable, and no additional lesions are visible. The patient is partially draped in a patterned hospital gown.

description.short_caption: Erythematous lesions on the left leg with central necrosis and surrounding inflammation.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the left leg with multiple erythematous lesions. A larger area of erythema is visible, with a central necrotic lesion marked by a black circle. The surrounding skin appears inflamed, with redness extending outward. A separate puncture site with a dressing is visible near the upper part of the image. The lesions suggest an infectious or inflammatory process.

description.short_caption: Histopathology of lung tissue showing fungal elements and necrosis.
description.detailed_description: This histopathology image shows lung tissue with areas of necrosis and numerous fungal elements, including septate hyphae with acute angle branching. The tissue is stained with a hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) stain, highlighting the fungal structures and surrounding necrotic areas. The fungal elements are suggestive of an invasive fungal infection, such as aspergillosis.
